### Jehovah-Jireh - One Year Devotions for Women
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/jehovah-jireh-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-10.html
Passage: Genesis 22:14
Points:
- God reveals Himself through the name Jehovah-Jireh, meaning the Lord will provide.
- Abraham demonstrated complete trust in God's promises by obeying even to the brink of losing Isaac.
- God intervened at the altar and provided a ram in the thicket as a substitute offering.
- This divine substitution foreshadowed the ultimate provision of God's Son dying for our sins.

### Abraham Passes His Test
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abraham-passes-his-test
Passage: Genesis 22:11-12
Points:
- The angel of the Lord stopped Abraham just in time, confirming he had passed the test.
- Biblical fear of God is not mere intellectual assent but faith proven through obedience.
- God's declaration that He knows Abraham reflects covenantal approval of those walking in faith.
- True devotion is evidenced by a willingness to surrender to God what is dearest to us.
